content:
The v4.17.0-rc1 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the release notes for details.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.17.0-rc1.

  • there is a v4.17.0-rc1 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

Notable changes include

  • Kernel checking now happens in parallel to elaboration (experimental, not yet enabled by default)
  • simp? can be used inside conv
  • bv_decide has more powerful preprocessing, enabling support for UIntX and certain structures, and a significant speed up on some problems
  • expansions of the BitVec / Array / Vector verification APIs.

and many many more changes in the release notes! Particularly exciting is all the groundwork for the forthcoming grind tactic.

Something that also made it into this release are improvements that cause docgen to linkify more notations.

Examples:

  • docs#exists_eq now has a linked exists notation.
  • docs#sign_apply now has a linked SignType.sign even though there's a function coercion.
  • docs#Nat.toFinset_factors now has dot notation links.
